cases.prompt: Our plant Gamma wants an andon board for the assembly line. I think plant Delta built one last year. Can you check whether we should just take theirs or specify a new one?
cases.expected_output:
Searches the reference library for a proven entry on the same capability before specifying anything.
Recommends taking the entry (as-is or adapted) if it exists and records only the plant's deltas.
Places the use case on an existing capability and process group without creating new ones.
Fills a standardization review and names the next skill (bc-build or dept-decision-rights).

cases.prompt: The library entry for our downtime reporting solution shows an empty CSP field. Our manager says it was rejected. How do I report this?
cases.expected_output:
Explains that a blank means the gate was not applied, not that the entry failed.
States a readiness verdict with what is missing instead of a rejection.
Does not call the entry catalogued, standard or CSP-approved.
Recommends only; the CSP decision sits outside OD.

cases.prompt: The tool tagged our new tablet use case as C12 other. I would like to change it to C05 by hand because it is obviously downtime. Is that okay?
cases.expected_output:
Refuses a hand-assigned tag and says to fix the input fields and re-run the classifier.
Treats C12 as a finding about thin intake text and re-checks the process-group link.
Points to the cluster baseline in the clusters reference.

cases.prompt: Three plants have asked us for the same scrap report over the last months. Should this become a standard use case?
cases.expected_output:
Switches to promotion mode and tests recurrence, value, reproducibility, placement, handover and catalog conditions.
States that refusing to promote is a valid result and does not invent a recurrence threshold.
Requires a named responsible human before recommending industrialization.

cases.prompt: A plant asks for a machine alert dashboard. Which catalogued use case matches their request, and can they order it themselves?
cases.expected_output:
Recognizes this as matching a request to the catalog, which belongs to catalog-usecase.
Does not run a cluster or CSP review.

should_trigger: Is this use case really standard, or just a copy of one plant's dashboard?
Plant B wants the same OEE screen plant A already runs, what do we reuse?
Which cluster does this use case belong to and what baseline checklist applies?
Why has our use case catalog not scaled across plants?
should_not_trigger: Which catalogued use case matches this plant request and which lane is it?
Write the business case and savings for this use case.
Which standard system or connection kit can the plant order for this machine?
Draft the story for Internal Communications about this use case.
